g3oz48ck.title: A36 Global Residency
g3oz48ck.description: A36 is a builder residency in Mumbai for people working on AI, Web3 and related technology, ending with a demo day. The registration page has October 18 to November 2 in its structured schedule, but the description still says the date is to be announced.
g3oz48ck.conflict: Structured schedule is October 18 to November 2, 2026; organizer description says Date: TBA. Retained for review, excluded from the dated public catalog.

ndrr1yqe.title: MIP-20
ndrr1yqe.description: ETHMumbai hosts MIP-20 as part of Road to Devcon. The organizer has not yet published the agenda.

3doehm1b.title: Run & Rave
3doehm1b.description: Orviq hosts a morning run around Bandra followed by music and coffee during India Blockchain Week and Devcon week.

9qtxqqxx.title: DeFi Security Summit
9qtxqqxx.description: DeFi Security Summit brings security researchers, auditors and protocol builders to Courtyard by Marriott Mumbai International Airport on November 1 and 2. Sessions run from 10:00 to 18:00 IST each day. The separate November 3 program at Devcon is not included in this registration.

83ujl6ms.title: Zcash World
83ujl6ms.description: Zcash India's one-day Mumbai event covers privacy, zero-knowledge proofs and Zcash. The program includes talks, project booths and activities using shielded wallets. Registration is required to see the venue.

1cnairat.title: Afterhours Mixer
1cnairat.description: Afterhours Mixer is an approval-based gathering hosted by Bitget during Mumbai's conference week. The organizer moved the event from Ravecon on November 4 to November 1, from 17:00 to 21:00 IST. Confirmed guests receive the venue details.

li3sv90r.title: Shaktipith
li3sv90r.description: Shaktipith is a women-only residency during Devcon week. The organizer lists six places and directs applications to shakti.web3events.in.

jb4zsel1.title: Catalyst
jb4zsel1.description: Catalyst is a founder residency during Devcon. The organizer lists support with branding, marketing, positioning, design and investment, alongside mentorship and expert sessions.

spsnos9t.title: Ethereum Cypherpunk Congress
spsnos9t.description: Web3Privacy Now hosts Ethereum Cypherpunk Congress #3 in Mumbai. The program addresses digital rights, open-source software, decentralization, cryptography and practical privacy tools.

solana-summit-india.title: Solana Summit India
solana-summit-india.description: Solana Summit India is a one-day program of talks, panels and workshops about the Solana ecosystem, real-world asset tokenization, regulation and development. Advance registration and host approval are required.

n0a39ago.title: Onchain Dev City
n0a39ago.description: BackersStage hosts Onchain Dev City during Devcon week. The announced program includes onchain quests, project pitches, talks and community activities.

team1mumbai.title: Team1 India
team1mumbai.description: Team1 India's Mumbai gala includes an introduction to Avalanche and the local ecosystem, a guest-speaker session and time for networking. Host approval is required; the exact address is shared with registered guests.

9bhu9f28.title: Crypto Mondays
9bhu9f28.description: CryptoMondays India plans a welcome session, a fireside discussion and lightning talks before open networking. The page's structured schedule uses Asia/Dubai, while the Mumbai agenda says 18:00 to 21:30 without clarifying the timezone.
9bhu9f28.conflict: Structured times are 14:00 to 17:30 UTC in Asia/Dubai (19:30 to 23:00 IST); Mumbai agenda and sheet say 18:00 to 21:30. Organizer clarification required; excluded from the dated public catalog.

quilla-vmnc.title: The Institutional Table
quilla-vmnc.description: QuillAudits hosts an invitation-only dinner about tokenization, stablecoins and institutional security. The discussion follows the Chatham House Rule, with no recording or press. Registration is a request for approval, and confirmed guests receive the venue.

rsm1xrxt.title: Sidequest: Chai
rsm1xrxt.description: Sidequest offers free morning chai during Devcon week. Attendees can join once or return on each of the four mornings; there is no formal program.

mc8pq06y.title: World of DeSci
mc8pq06y.description: The DeSci Community Hub at Devcon covers biotechnology, AI, neuroscience, climate and community governance across four days. Sessions include posters and interactive discussions. A Luma RSVP does not provide access to Devcon; a separate Devcon ticket is required.

a0e6b8at.title: AI ECONOMIC FORUM
a0e6b8at.description: Omniscient AI's Mumbai forum covers AI infrastructure, models, agents, AI and Web3, investment, enterprise applications and policy. The announced program includes keynotes, panels, product demonstrations and founder sessions.

h0x443s9.title: The Money House
h0x443s9.description: The Money House is an invitation-led gathering during India Blockchain Week and Devcon. The planned program includes roundtables, founder stories, product demos and interviews about payments, banking, stablecoins and financial infrastructure. RSVP does not guarantee admission.

08ogvz1i.title: Ready for the Run
08ogvz1i.description: Infini3's Mumbai stop in the Ready for the Run series focuses on capital for AI and Web3. The meetup includes discussions, live polling and conversations between builders and investors.

mh0xmqg0.title: Media Accelerator
mh0xmqg0.description: BFM Times hosts a startup cohort during Devcon week, offering media exposure, mentorship and pitching opportunities for blockchain, AI and Web3 startups. Funding and ecosystem rewards are subject to selection and eligibility.

nyw6qigp.title: Sidequest: Kulfi
nyw6qigp.description: Sidequest offers free kulfi near the conference venue on afternoons during Devcon week. Attendees can stop for ice cream and informal conversation.

2kj0jqf9.title: Sidequest: Happy Hour
2kj0jqf9.description: Sidequest runs an evening happy hour during Devcon week with free entry. The host for each evening provides the first round.

uqmzpq5k.title: Fluid at Mumbai
uqmzpq5k.description: Fluid hosts an evening with its team during Devcon in Mumbai. Discussion topics include capital efficiency, lending, borrowing and trading.

czi58jpe.title: EIP Hub
czi58jpe.description: EIP Hub is a four-day space for Ethereum Improvement Proposals, ERC standards and protocol upgrades. The planned program covers the EIP process, core protocol development, application standards and enterprise adoption through talks, workshops and office hours. A valid Devcon ticket is required to enter.

sgrf4yq5.title: Liquidity Pool
sgrf4yq5.description: Liquidity Pool is listed for Devcon week in Mumbai, from 21:30 IST on November 3 to 00:30 on November 4. The organizer has not published a program; registration is required to see the exact location.

ib9j3xxe.title: Sidequest: Explore Mumbai
ib9j3xxe.description: Sidequest offers free guided walks through different parts of Mumbai during Devcon week. Attendees should check the organizer's calendar for each day's meeting point.
ib9j3xxe.note: Structured span is November 4 at 04:30 to November 7 at 08:30 IST; copy refers generally to Devcon week and afternoon walks. Preserve the source span without inventing daily sessions.

qk93a446.title: Monad Blitz Mumbai
qk93a446.description: Monad Blitz Mumbai is a one-day hackathon during Devcon week, with workshops and mentorship. Teams of two or three build and demonstrate projects on Monad; the organizer lists a US$5,000 prize pool.

7729jnr3.title: The Yield Layer
7729jnr3.description: Launchnodes and GSR Foundation host a program about using staking and stablecoin yield to fund social impact. The agenda includes fireside conversations, a keynote and panels with donors, foundations and builders.

cw0h549b.title: Onchain Legal Summit
cw0h549b.description: Entity's Onchain Legal Summit examines the legal status of onchain entities, AI agents and DAOs. Announced topics include governance, liability, arbitration and cross-jurisdictional compliance. The detailed agenda is still to be announced.

6gnkjcqx.title: Digital Asset Regulation
6gnkjcqx.description: Trilegal and Fractional host a roundtable on India's digital-asset regulation and tax framework, with comparisons to the United States, European Union and Singapore. Registration starts at 16:00 IST, the discussion runs from 16:30 to 17:45, and a mixer follows until 18:30.

hr8w0hmd.title: Diyas
hr8w0hmd.description: ArQ's NEAR event uses a team game to demonstrate cross-chain intents. Attendees form groups, assemble an intent and watch an operator execute a small onchain transaction, with a testnet fallback.

ai6owvhz.title: EVA Symposium III
ai6owvhz.description: The Ethereum Validators Association hosts an invitation-only symposium for validators, staking operators, researchers and infrastructure providers. The evening includes an EVA update and dinner. Registration requires approval; the full program and speakers are still to be announced.

xuofsg0p.title: NEAR x Quantus
xuofsg0p.description: NEAR and Quantus host a happy hour during Devcon Mumbai, focused on quantum-resistant infrastructure and confidential cross-chain transactions.

qzzu690f.title: Collateral Call
qzzu690f.description: Alpend hosts an approval-based evening about institutional credit on Canton Network. The program starts with cocktails at 18:30 IST, followed by a fireside conversation at 19:30 and dinner at 20:00. Confirmed guests receive the exact venue.

islzi7v3.title: Money Layer
islzi7v3.description: Capvise Global hosts Money Layer during Devcon week in Mumbai. The gathering is for founders, developers, wallet and stablecoin teams, fintech companies and investors.

80bnxbwi.title: Quantstamp x Common Defense
80bnxbwi.description: Quantstamp and Common Defense host an evening for people working in Web3, AI and security during Devcon. Food and drinks are provided. Entry requires an approved registration QR code.

kz3klqjq.title: Capital connect
kz3klqjq.description: Capital connect is an invitation-only event for limited partners, venture capital investors and other participants in the Web3 ecosystem.

ub56pe38.title: Frontier Of Intelligence
ub56pe38.description: Frontier of Intelligence is a hackathon covering autonomous AI agents, decentralized AI infrastructure and real-world applications. The announced tracks include onchain agent coordination, verifiable inference and distributed compute.

5u1evsou.title: Builders Brunch
5u1evsou.description: Buildify hosts a brunch for Ethereum builders, founders and creators during Devcon in Mumbai. The event is scheduled for November 5 from 13:00 to 16:00 IST; the venue is to be announced.

tbe-devcon26.title: The Best Event
tbe-devcon26.description: The Best Event's Afterdark program includes VIP networking from 19:00 to 21:00 IST, followed by the main event until 01:30. VIP networking is limited to VIP ticket holders; general admission to the main event is first come, first served.

ena53peq.title: Biggest CT
ena53peq.description: The organizer describes a meetup for crypto traders, builders and creators. Its structured schedule says November 5, while the description says December 6 from 16:00 to 19:00.
ena53peq.conflict: Structured schedule says November 5, 2026 at 19:30 to November 6 at 01:00 IST; description says December 6 at 16:00 to 19:00. Existing record retained for review and excluded from the dated public catalog.

np3wx7v5.title: MONEY MAKER
np3wx7v5.description: MONEY MAKER examines monetary systems, central banking, stablecoins, incentive design, security, privacy and AI. The organizer plans talks followed by dinner and an after-party. This is not ETHGlobal Mumbai, despite the spreadsheet's Day 1 link.

quilla-rvp4.title: Ship Safe
quilla-rvp4.description: QuillAudits hosts security sessions covering exploit analysis, audit readiness and AI-assisted auditing during Devcon. The planned program includes a panel and networking from 18:45 IST. Registration is reviewed, and confirmed attendees receive the venue.

tswdcctj.title: Devcon Afterparty
tswdcctj.description: The organizer lists this as an unofficial after-party for Devcon 8. Registration is required to see the exact venue.

v0fimew1.title: Crypto Afterhours
v0fimew1.description: Mandala Network hosts its Mumbai edition of Crypto Afterhours during Devcon week. The exact venue is available to registered guests.

0ej7kbb0.title: ETHwali
0ej7kbb0.description: ETHwali is a Diwali celebration for the Ethereum community during Devcon season in Mumbai. The organizer plans an evening of music and community activities.
